  "body": "#### Topics in Private Chats

Bots and users can organize long-running private conversations into **separate topics** – for example, one topic for an order, another for technical support and a third for a recurring task. This makes it easier to keep several conversations with the same bot neatly separated without opening multiple chats.

[![

](/file/400780400227/2/btvhtJcqT_A.76194.jpg/b56e1d38cc2e92e2aa)](/file/400780400658/2/zyAsgGtzdvg.5107918.mp4/413b3825ef972abc2a)

> Private-chat topics need to be enabled for the bot via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather). See [createForumTopic](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createforumtopic), [editForumTopic](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editforumtopic) and [deleteForumTopic](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deleteforumtopic) for more information.

---

### AI Agents

Telegram is the only platform where all **AI models** can [compete](https://telegram.org/blog/ai-bot-revolution-11-new-features) freely – while users remain in control of their experience. Third-party [AI bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#ai-agents) are welcome to communicate with users and [each other](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#bot-to-bot-communication) (as long as they stick to the [rules](https://telegram.org/tos/bot-developers#4-3-data-scraping)).

Telegram apps natively support **AI interfaces** such as [threaded conversations](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#topics-in-private-chats) and [real-time streaming for responses](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#streaming-replies). Users can quickly [summon specialized assistants](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#guest-bots) into the same conversation, bring several agents together around one task or instruct them to [manage their account](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#business-bots).

[![

](/file/400780400227/2/btvhtJcqT_A.76194.jpg/b56e1d38cc2e92e2aa)](/file/400780400658/2/zyAsgGtzdvg.5107918.mp4/413b3825ef972abc2a)

> The Bot API provides the messaging, multi-platform presentation, access and lifecycle features – the model, memory and bot logic are flexible and entirely up to you.

Here are a few examples of what you can build:

* A **research assistant** that streams a comparison of several sources and then presents the result as a structured report with links and follow-up buttons.
* A **group helper** that can be mentioned for translation, fact-checking, image generation or another context-specific task without being added to the group.
* A **multi-agent workflow** where a coordinator bot asks specialist bots to review, translate, schedule or process an order before combining the results.
* A **business secretary** that processes incoming business messages and performs only the actions allowed by the account owner.

The individual building blocks are described in more detail throughout this page:

* [Topics in Private Chats](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#topics-in-private-chats) keep separate projects or support cases organized – improving on established web-based AI chat UIs.
* [Streaming Replies](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#streaming-replies) show progress while the agent works and allow users to stop a draft at any point.
* [Rich Messages](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#rich-messages) turn the final result into a structured report, checklist, comparison, explanation or interactive flow.
* [Guest Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#guest-bots) and [Inline Mode](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-requests) make specialized agents available where they are needed.
* [Bot-to-Bot Communication](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#bot-to-bot-communication) and [Managed Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#managed-bots) enable delegation, coordination and complex multi-agent setups.
* [Business Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#business-bots) allow account automation with explicit rights, while [Mini Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#mini-apps) provide a richer workspace for configuration, approvals and dashboards.

> This page and the full [Bot API documentation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api) document itself are AI-friendly! If you'd like to build a bot but have limited coding experience, simply direct your favorite AI tool to read our documentation and help you get started.

---

### Media and Messaging

Bots can create **polls and quizzes**, manage collaborative **checklists** and send rich media such as **Live Photos** – giving users more ways to interact with your service.

#### Polls and Quizzes

Polls are useful for collecting feedback, running surveys, testing knowledge or letting users choose what happens next. In addition to regular polls, bots can create quizzes and control how users participate.

[![

](/file/400780400259/3/6devMXGy5_4.64419.jpg/daf64674e5523b9426)](/file/400780400118/1/j6mkunphO2E.7657802.mp4/b669e7300f659bd00a)

> Bots can also add poll media or links, restrict participation and let users suggest new options. See [Poll](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#poll) and [sendPoll](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpoll) for the full list of available options.

#### Checklists

With **checklists**, bots can help teams and individuals track tasks without leaving Telegram. They are useful for project handoffs, event preparation, moderation queues, shopping lists and other shared activities.

[![

](/file/400780400269/3/sxD0KDicJWk.51274.jpg/7084e243a25b46704f)](/file/400780400317/2/QZU-sxLjJoo.3068919.mp4/e44f8b16684e7f8bff)

> You can check (pun intended) the [Checklist](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#checklist) documentation for all available features.

#### Live Photos

Bots can send **Live Photos** – a photo paired with a short video – and use them in albums and paid media. This is useful for eventful moments, product previews, interactive albums and other content where a still image does not do the shot justice.

[![

](/file/400780400645/2/KJSuP7na3nY.63428.jpg/5bee0074b97571feb1)](/file/400780400607/3/DyZaAN7_tWw.6352123.mp4/17bd9b603a88ed1e08)

> See [LivePhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#livephoto), [sendLivePhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlivephoto) and [sendMediaGroup](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmediagroup) to get started.

---

### Integration

There are various ways of further integrating bots with Telegram and other services.

* Use [Mini Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#mini-apps) to bring complete services into Telegram.
* Build tools and integrate [business services](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#business-bots).
* Accept [Payments](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#payments) via third-party payment providers that support integration with Bots and Mini Apps.
* Connect to Telegram using the [Web Login](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#web-login) functionality.
* Create gaming bots by integrating [HTML5 Games](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#html5-games).
* Help users create and manage [Telegram Stickers](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#stickers-and-custom-emoji).

### Communities

Telegram's [Communities](https://telegram.org/blog/communities-editor-invisible-messages) feature connects several groups, channels and bots around a shared topic or audience.

Bot have extensive, granual chat management capabilities that can be useful for cross-chat onboarding, shared moderation workflows and community-wide notifications.

[![

](/file/400780400627/2/m0_w0ABzq9E.64892.jpg/dd79c8957289c99b38)](/file/400780400937/7/7FrlfQ3X9TA.9490984.mp4/905d7975740c1999ae)

> See [Community](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#community), [CommunityChatAdded](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#communitychatadded), [CommunityChatJoined](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#communitychatjoined), [CommunityChatRemoved](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#communitychatremoved) and [ChatFullInfo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatfullinfo) for the relevant objects and updates.

### Channel Direct Messages and Suggested Posts

Channels can have a dedicated forum-like directory for direct messages where users can privately **contact the channel** staff in a chat topic. Bots with the appropriate channel access can send messages to a specific such topic, identify the parent channel and respond to incoming messages.

item.text:
Используется [`createForumTopic`](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createforumtopic). Предварительно включите темы личных чатов у бота через [@BotFather](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#topics-in-private-chats).

Нужны установленный `httpx` и токен бота в переменной окружения `BOT_TOKEN`.

```python
import os

import httpx

token = os.environ["BOT_TOKEN"]

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(
        f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/createForumTopic",
        json={"chat_id": 777000111, "name": "Заказы"},
    )
    data = response.json()

    if not data.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Bot API: {data.get('error_code', response.status_code)} — "
            f"{data.get('description', 'Неизвестная ошибка')}"
        )

    response.raise_for_status()
    topic = data["result"]

print("Тема создана. message_thread_id:", topic["message_thread_id"])
```

Код отправляет один запрос к Bot API:

```json
[
  {
    "method": "createForumTopic",
    "params": {
      "chat_id": 777000111,
      "name": "Заказы"
    }
  }
]
```
